title: Pluralization of Vowel-Ending Nouns
summary: Pluralizing Persian nouns ending in vowels (ا, و, ه) using glide consonants (ی, گ).
explanation: When adding '-ان' to nouns ending in vowels, insert glide consonants like 'ی' (دانا -> دانایان) or 'گ' (بنده -> بندگان).

example_translations.ex_vpl_1: The wise people and orators of the country gathered together.

common_error_explanations.err_vpl_1: Insert the glide consonant 'ی' or 'گ' when pluralizing vowel-ending words.
